# Issue Templates

When creating an issue, please use one of our templates:

- **Development task** - Scoped implementation/documentation task
- **Research task** - Source-backed investigation, no code changes
- **Review task** - Independent review against task criteria
- **Bug Report** - Report a bug or issue
- **Feature Request** - Suggest a new feature
- **Epic** - Large initiative spanning multiple issues

Process rules for agents and contributors:
[docs/contributing/agent-workflow.md](../docs/contributing/agent-workflow.md).
Templates contain no agent mentions; the lead dispatches work in a separate comment.

Thank you for contributing!
